held.limitations: Three participants and one experiment; the exact person bootstrap and omitted-person means are descriptive. Earlier spikes are observed at each forecast time. Skin afferent activity is a direct single-unit measurement. Force is measured at the apparatus; this evaluation cannot establish a causal effect or whole-limb/neural-system generalization.

decision: The seven-task fit remains the default. The eight-task fit had higher error on six earlier assessments, and the touch-only fit made better touch forecasts in each of the three new people. The Touch study launcher lets you run and compare the experimental shared weights.
